g.text: Topology: Synchronous 5-Stage Level-Shifted Dickson Multiplier (Zero Zener / Low Noise)
Architecture: AC Drive from SW1 (Parallel Flying Caps) | DC Base tied to +8.32V Rail
LEVEL-SHIFT BASE BUS (+8.32V Regulated DC from OUT1)
• High frequency (1.536 MHz) delivers ultra-low output impedance (R_out < 5 kΩ) with tiny 0603 caps.
• High impedance node (1GΩ, Capsule, OPA1656 Gate) encircled by GUARD RING
• Driven by OPA1656 buffer output to eliminate surface PCB leakage current (< 1pA)
• Clean with ultrasonic IPA bath; no solder mask over 1GΩ traces.
ANTIGRAVITY AUDIO ARCHITECTURE • ULTRA-LOW NOISE +48V CONDENSER MICROPHONE BIAS SUBSYSTEM
